# IB Premium Art – Construction & Interior Finishing Specialists

> IB Premium Art is a certified construction company based in Stajkovci, Skopje, North Macedonia. Established in 2018, the company specializes in professional dry construction systems (Knauf, Rigips, Tehnogips), high-end suspended ceilings (Armstrong, Hunter Douglas), plastering, whitewashing, and decorative painting across North Macedonia.

## Primary Core Services

### 1. Knauf Drywall & Ceiling Systems (Knauf Системи)
- Complete installation of Knauf gypsum board partition walls (преградни ѕидови), wall linings, moisture-resistant solutions (W313 for wet rooms), and thermal/acoustic insulation systems.
- Trained according to Knauf manufacturer standards.

### 2. Rigips Systems (Saint-Gobain)
- Advanced installation of Rigips gypsum wall and ceiling systems for complex architectural shapes, curved surfaces, decorative niches, and fire protection rated partitions (F30/F60).

### 3. Tehnogips Systems
- High-efficiency installation of Tehnogips gypsum boards, plasters, joint compounds, and partition walls with optimum quality-to-price ratio.

### 4. Armstrong Suspended Ceilings (Armstrong Плафони)
- Assembly of Armstrong suspended ceiling grids, mineral tiles, and metal tiles for commercial, office, and industrial spaces requiring acoustic dampening and easy infrastructure access.

### 5. Hunter Douglas Architectural Ceilings (Hunter Douglas Плафони)
- Installation of premium Hunter Douglas linear metal ceilings, decorative slats, and architectural ceiling solutions for luxury residential, hotel, shopping center, and public projects.

### 6. Painting, Plastering & Whitewashing (Молерај, Глетување и Кречење)
- Professional surface preparation, multi-layer skim coating (глетување / шпакловање), whitewashing (кречење), interior decorative painting, textured finishes, and flawless wall transformations.

## Target Service Areas
- Skopje (All municipalities including Centar, Karposh, Aerodrom, Gazi Baba, Kisela Voda, Gjorche Petrov, Chair, Butel, Kisela Voda, Stajkovci).
- All regions and municipalities across North Macedonia (Куманово, Битола, Охрид, Тетово, Велес, Штип, Струмица, Прилеп, Гостивар, etc.).
